disclosures: Actual browser and desktop Excel window recordings, operated by an agent through approved UI tools.
Two separate takes joined chronologically within each take. Setup, waits and navigation retries are omitted.
Selected intervals play at normal speed, resampled to 10 fps. No invented application screens, cell values, pointer motion or narration.
Excel crops remove unused right-hand columns and the account/profile area while retaining the formula bar, Save control and workbook title.
The blank template and source identity metadata were prepared before capture; amounts and formulas were entered through Excel during capture.
The review-note paste initially landed one column to the right. Its correction is retained, not presented as an issuer discrepancy.
Delivery-workbook metadata sanitization and disclosed formatting cleanup occurred after capture.
This demonstrates work to automate, not native Cowork creation, installation, invocation or evaluation.

clips.title: Find the filing
clips.action: Open the FY2024 10-K from the SEC filing index.
clips.target: Resolve the issuer, accession and reporting period before collecting any values.

clips.title: Download the original
clips.action: Use Menu > Save XBRL Zip File in the SEC Inline Viewer.
clips.target: Retain the downloaded source, not just a search snippet or copied answer.
clips.detail: An actual accession ZIP was downloaded locally. Its fingerprint is in source.json.

clips.title: Download the original
clips.action: Open the original HTML filing from the viewer.
clips.target: Keep a traceable source document for the spreadsheet update.

clips.title: Choose the right table
clips.action: Navigate to the consolidated income statement in Item 8.
clips.target: Distinguish the company statement from the separate equity-method investee summary.
clips.detail:
Printed page 62
USD millions
2024 and 2023 from this one filing

clips.title: Choose the right table
clips.action: Select and copy the statement cells in the browser.
clips.target: Capture the source table, including its awkward formatting, before normalizing it.
clips.detail: The source also contains a 2022 column. The model uses only 2024 and 2023.

clips.title: Transfer into Excel
clips.action: Paste the original table at Raw paste!A5.
clips.target: Keep a source trail while separating raw HTML cells from clean numeric inputs.
clips.detail: Real paste: dollar-sign cells, spacer columns and all three source years are retained.

clips.title: Transfer into Excel
clips.action: Enter twelve numeric amounts into Statement!B5:C10.
clips.target: Map six metrics to the correct years without rescaling, rounding or changing signs.
clips.detail:
Blue inputs on yellow cells
B = 2024 | C = 2023
Units stay in USD millions

clips.title: Build live calculations
clips.action: Enter dollar and percentage change formulas.
clips.target: Calculate from cell references instead of typing the answers.
clips.detail:
D5 = B5-C5
E5 = IF(C5=0,"Not meaningful",D5/C5)
Continue through row 10.

clips.title: Build live calculations
clips.action: Recompute gross profit and operating income, then compare to the filing.
clips.target: Expose transcription or reference errors rather than forcing a tie.
clips.detail:
Gross profit = revenue - COGS
Operating income = gross profit - SG&A - other charges
Zero differences display as dashes.

clips.title: Build live calculations
clips.action: Calculate gross and operating margins in Excel.
clips.target: Keep derived metrics live when source inputs change.
clips.detail:
Gross margin: B12/B5
Operating margin: B14/B5
Apply the same references to column C.

clips.title: Build live calculations
clips.action: Add the completeness and tie-out control.
clips.target: An incomplete transfer must not be reported as reconciled.
clips.detail:
Count all 12 inputs first.
Then test all four differences.
Observed result: Ties to filing.

clips.title: Document the review
clips.action: Record the source scope and pending human review.
clips.target: Preserve why this table and these periods were chosen.
clips.detail: This paste lands one column right of the headers. The next cut shows its correction.

clips.title: Document the review
clips.action: Move the review note into the correct columns.
clips.target: Check field alignment, not just whether text appeared somewhere on the sheet.

clips.title: Mark the draft honestly
clips.action: Replace the template's initial pending-inputs note.
clips.target: Keep the narrative status consistent with the populated model.
clips.detail:
New status:
Draft populated from filing; pending human review.

clips.title: Mark the draft honestly
clips.action: Commit the updated status in the worksheet.
clips.target: A successful tie-out is not human approval of the financial analysis.
clips.detail: The original source citation remains below the status note.

clips.title: Save the working draft
clips.action: Return to the completed two-year statement.
clips.target: Review inputs, live calculations and the control together before saving.
clips.detail:
12 reported amounts
25 Excel formulas
Human review still pending

clips.title: Save the working draft
clips.action: Use Excel's Save control and retain the local workbook.
clips.target: Persist the actual formulas and Excel's calculated results, not a picture of a table.
clips.detail:
The title shows Saved to this PC.
Delivery copy: completed.xlsx
No posting, payment or trading.
